# The Dig

> The Dig pools estate sales from the public listing boards into one map per city. Facts shown, always linked back to the source listing.

## What it is
- A free map and list of estate sales, one page per city, rebuilt once a day from public JSON feeds.
- Each sale shows what its source listing published: title, company, dates, hours, and the street address once the company releases it.
- The Dig does not run or verify sales. The source listing is the authority.

## Cities
Live and proving are what the city index said when this site was built. Texas is first. More states are being scouted and none is named until it has a real feed.

### Live
- Houston: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/houston/
  This weekend: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/houston/this-weekend/
  JSON feed: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities/houston/sales.json
  28 sales in the feed, collected 2026-11-21T01:26:19.206Z. Times are America/Chicago.

### Proving (preview)
None at this build. A proving city appears here on the first rebuild after its feed is published at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities/<slug>/sales.json
The index names 3 more cities with no pages on this site yet (no feed yet).

## Regions and search
- Regions page (live cities, preview cities, what comes next): https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/regions/
- Search page, across every live and proving city: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/search/
  Link straight to a search: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/search/?q=<words>&cat=<category-id>[,<category-id>]
- Search data the page filters in the browser: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/search/data.json
  28 records, one per sale page: id, city, title, company, categories, first and last day, lat, lng, sale page URL, source listing URL.
- Category ids: tools, furniture, vinyl-records, jewelry, collectibles, vehicles, kitchen, clothing, books, art, electronics, toys-games
- A keyword matches the start of any word in a sale's title, company or categories. Search does not look inside photos yet.

## Public data
- City index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities.json
- Combined search feed, every sale from the live and proving cities in one file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/search.json
  Not published when this site was built (HTTP 404). Until it is, use the search data file above.
- Per-city feeds follow the pattern https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities/<slug>/sales.json
- In a feed, "addressHidden": true means no street address has been released and the map point is approximate.

## Pages
- One page per sale: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sale/<sale-id>/ where <sale-id> is the sale's "id" in the feed. Each has schema.org Event data.
- Sale pages are removed when a sale leaves the feed.
- Sitemap: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sitemap.xml

## How to cite
Link the sale's page on The Dig and the source listing that page names. Example:
"Estate sale listed on The Dig (https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sale/<sale-id>/), original listing: <source listing URL>."
Do not present The Dig as the organizer of a sale.

## Contact
No contact address is live yet. listings@thedig.example is a placeholder and does not receive mail.
